scope_note: This is a release-governance inventory, not a legal opinion or a complete file-level SPDX SBOM. A component marked blocked must not be included in the named release profiles until the required action is completed and recorded.

release_profiles.repository-public: Publication or redistribution of the complete repository.
release_profiles.firmware-source: Publication or redistribution of either firmware source tree.
release_profiles.firmware-binary: Distribution of linked firmware images such as ELF, HEX or BIN.
release_profiles.mechanical: Publication or redistribution of mechanical CAD, DXF and BOM material.

components.name: 26-EngBot project-authored firmware contributions
components.copyright_holder: 26-EngBot contributors, only where they hold the necessary rights
components.required_action: Apply this grant only after file provenance confirms that the contributors had authority to license the file. File-level and third-party notices take precedence.

components.name: 26-EngBot project-authored mechanical design source
components.copyright_holder: 26-EngBot contributors, only where they hold the necessary rights
components.required_action: Separate project-authored source from supplier, manufacturer and RoboMaster models before redistribution.

components.name: Arm CMSIS
components.copyright_holder: Arm Limited and contributors identified in file headers
components.required_action: Preserve the bundled license and all copyright notices.

components.name: STMicroelectronics STM32F4 HAL/LL
components.required_action: Preserve the bundled license and source headers; retain the original STM32Cube package version/provenance record when available.

components.name: STMicroelectronics CMSIS device support
components.required_action: Preserve the bundled license and source headers; retain the original STM32Cube package version/provenance record when available.

components.name: FreeRTOS kernel and CMSIS-RTOS adaptation
components.copyright_holder: Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates and identified contributors
components.required_action: Preserve the copyright and permission notice in source and substantial portions.

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library
components.required_action: Record a release-specific compliance decision for SLA0044 clauses 4 and 5, confirm use only with ST-manufactured devices, and preserve the complete SLA0044 notice. Do not describe this component as Apache/MIT/BSD software.

components.name: SEGGER Real Time Transfer
components.required_action: Preserve every SEGGER source-file copyright, redistribution condition and disclaimer; do not replace them with the project license header.

components.name: HNU YueLu EC all-rights-reserved firmware
components.copyright_holder: HNU YueLu EC and named authors
components.required_action: Obtain written authorization from the actual rights holder covering modification, source redistribution and binary distribution, or replace the code with a clean, clearly licensed implementation. Never remove or overwrite the existing notice as a substitute for permission.

components.name: Wang Hongxi named algorithms and INS support
components.required_action: Record the original project, version, source URL and license, plus the local modification history; obtain authorization or replace the implementation if no redistributable license can be proved.

components.name: DJI-attributed remote-control and OLED font material
components.required_action: Locate the authoritative DJI distribution terms and version. Obtain redistribution permission or replace/remove the material from the release package.

components.name: Motor, encoder and BMI088 device drivers with incomplete provenance
components.copyright_holder: NOASSERTION; mixed project, manufacturer or network provenance
components.required_action: Create a file-level provenance record with upstream URL/package, version, copyright holder, license and local changes. Obtain permission or replace every file that remains unlicensed.

components.name: Precompiled CMSIS-DSP libraries
components.required_action: Identify the exact upstream package and version and confirm that its binary redistribution terms cover these archives. Do not infer binary terms solely from adjacent source licenses.

components.name: Vendor manuals, protocols and datasheets
components.required_action: Record the authoritative download URL and redistribution terms for each document. Remove it from public release packages and link to the publisher when redistribution permission is absent.

components.name: Mechanical CAD containing mixed original and supplier/manufacturer models
components.copyright_holder: Mixed 26-EngBot contributors, suppliers, manufacturers and RoboMaster
components.required_action: Classify CAD files at file level. Keep confirmed project-authored sources under CERN-OHL-P-2.0 and exclude or separately authorize supplier, manufacturer and RoboMaster models.
